dataformats.why: Testing regexes and date conversions on real strings builds the instinct faster than reading rules.

pytooling.why: Tooling sticks once you set up a real repo yourself; short explanations say why each tool exists.

entnetwork.why: Network failures are diagnosed by answering questions in order, which a decision tree tool lets you practise.

poc.why: POC work is mostly written agreements: success criteria, scope, estimates and RFP answers you fill in.
